description: An app customers can sign up for from its own page, such as frappe.io/raven.

fields.description: The value in the signup link, such as raven in /signup?product=raven. It cannot change after creation.
fields.label: Product Key

fields.description: A disabled product refuses new signups. Its existing sites keep running.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Shown under the heading on the signup and login pages. Leave empty to show no subtitle.
fields.label: Subtitle

fields.description: The app Cargo installs on this product's image, such as raven. A trial starts the newest signup image whose app tag has this value.
fields.label: Signup App

fields.description: Where the owner lands after signing in to a trial site, such as /raven, so the app can run its own setup. Leave empty to open Desk.
fields.label: Landing Route

name: Product
